foam.material: Rigid craft foam, provisional low-force commissioning only

mount.load_path: Baseline clamps through the3mm PETG base and7mm deck; no metal bypass or rated clamp torque is claimed.

jaws.retainers: 4 x M3x8 ISO7380 button screws,4 x OD7 ID3.2 x0.5 washers,4 x M3 AF5.5x2.4 plain nuts
jaws.adjusters: 2 x M4x25 ISO4762 cap screws and2 x M4 DIN985 AF7x5 nyloc nuts
jaws.pads: 4 x50x14x2mm EVA, attach to fixture only

restraint.ties: 2 x4.8x300mm nylon cable ties, thickness<=1.2mm, head envelope<=12x8x6mm; trim tails and replace ties for blank removal
restraint.route: Each same-side pair links underbase through a2mm-deep groove, up both sides, and over its keeper rail atX+/-25. Keep the42mm centre opening free.
restraint.keeper_pad: 50mm outside /42mm inside square ring x1mm EVA

limits: Foam blank is an invented sample envelope, not a selected workpiece. No stone/wood/metal workholding is claimed.
Actual clamp torque, pad compression, dimensional fit, foam crushing/marking and restraint strength require coupon/bench tests before cutting.
Current folded arm pose only; no articulated spindle/tool path or cutting capability is certified.
Geometry-only installed/sweep proof; print and physical holding tests remain pending.
instructions: Baseline is a provisional50x50x40mm low-force foam blank only. Keep lower17mm and sacrificial outer border unmachined.

Fit all captured nuts and route two 4.8 mm ties through the base slots and underside grooves before mounting. Seat the base on the clean dry platter. Verify M6 washer thickness,3mm base and8-9mm actual blind engagement. No screw may bottom.
Bond EVA pads to the fixture only. Fit bottom pad and blank into the padded fixed corner, advance both jaws gently, then lock the M3 retainers without crushing foam.
Fit the keeper pad and open keeper. Wrap the two prerouted ties around the outside edges and over the keeper rails. Tighten and trim the tails. The ties provide independent upward restraint.
For unloading, cut the ties and lift the keeper 25 mm. Loosen the jaw retainers, back off both adjusters by 2 mm and lift the foam 25 mm. Lift the base to route fresh ties for the next blank.
Clamp force, torque, thread stack, pad compression, restraint strength, foam marking and actual tool/harness clearance require physical acceptance.
